rent_increase.text: Demo rule: a landlord normally has to give written notice before raising rent, often at least three months ahead. Check the current local tenancy law before you act.

letter.subject: Request for information on rent increase
letter.body:
Dear landlord,

I have received notice of a rent increase from €850 to €920 per month. Please confirm the effective date, the legal basis for the change, and that the required notice period has been respected.

Kind regards,
Alex

stop_food.title: Stop food delivery
stop_food.headline: +€540 in your cushion after six months
stop_food.summary: Cutting €150 a month of food delivery: about 40% goes to groceries and 60% to your cushion.

mortgage_rate.title: Interest rate up 0.5 pp
mortgage_rate.headline: Cushion falls to about €408
mortgage_rate.summary: A 0.5 pp rise at the 1 March review adds about €32 a month to your mortgage payment. The change applies from the review date, not today.

cut_leisure.title: Skip cinema and football for 2 months
cut_leisure.headline: +€50 in your cushion in two months
cut_leisure.summary: Skipping cinema, theatre and football for two months frees about €50.
